Hello! I'm Lyon, your service agent for buying and selling used iPhones.

I can help you with two main services:
• **List an iPhone for Sale:** I'll add your used iPhone to my inventory, and it will be visible to potential buyers. This service costs 20 TK / Kookies.
• **Browse Available iPhones:** You can look through my current inventory of used iPhones. This service is free.

What can I help you with today?
